title: Only 1% Pass This Animal Quiz!
hook: Only 1% of people can name these animals!
script:
Only 1% of people can name these animals! Think you're an animal expert? Test your knowledge with three rapid-fire questions. You'll have just three seconds for each, so stay sharp! Let's find out if you belong to the elite.

Question one: Which incredible animal is renowned for its ability to change color and blend seamlessly into its surroundings? Think fast! (Pause for 3 seconds) Time is up! The correct answer is the Chameleon. What an amazing adaptation!

Moving on to question two: Known as the 'king of the jungle,' what majestic big cat is native to Africa and India, famous for its powerful roar? Three seconds, starting now! (Pause for 3 seconds) Did you get it? It's the mighty Lion!

And for the final challenge, question three: What's the largest land animal on Earth, recognized by its enormous ears and long trunk? Your last chance to prove yourself! (Pause for 3 seconds) The answer is the magnificent African Elephant! Truly incredible.

How did you do? Count up your correct answers. If you scored a perfect three out of three, congratulations! You're truly in that exclusive one percent of animal trivia champions. Now, can you really name these animals?
